notes:
## 0.4.6

- The updater now verifies the SHA-256 hash of every downloaded Revit add-in file before installing it
- Release ZIP files and individual release assets now publish SHA-256 checksums, with a post-release verifier confirming the published downloads
- A documented manual installation and verification route is now available for corporate environments or installations where running the EXE is not permitted

## 0.4.5

### Find & Replace

- Find & Replace can now search and replace writable string parameters on title block instances, title block types, and their sheets
- Choose the search targets explicitly, including text, tags, view names, and title blocks; the preview more clearly separates eligible, excluded, and unavailable rows

### CAD Layer Manager

- CAD Layer Manager now lets you stage visibility changes for whole imported-CAD groups as well as individual layers, and apply the changes to the active view or its template
- Add projection and cut line/pattern, transparency, halftone, and colour overrides for selected CAD layers
- Search all imported CAD layers independently from saved rule expressions; combine multiple expressions with **AND** or **OR**, and reset them when needed
- Improved group interaction: expand or collapse groups, select or deselect all, select groups alongside layers, and keep collapsed groups and hidden parent categories clear and predictable

### Parameter workflows

- **Create Direct Filter** has been replaced by **Filter by Parameter**, with a guided parameter-filter workflow, reliable category picking, and back navigation
- **Select by Parameter** now supports family and non-filterable parameters more reliably, handles duplicate parameter names and types, and has improved picker, wizard, and keyboard navigation

### Other improvements

- **View Template Snapshot** import preview now has keyboard navigation, selectable category hierarchies, selection counts, and category groups collapsed by default
- **What's Changed** now renders Markdown, including headings, lists, emphasis, code, and links
- **Tag CAD Layers** now validates positive numeric settings as you enter them; it remains a work-in-progress tool
- Several tools have clearer names, including **Batch Link Files**, **Project Tab Colors**, **Section / Scope Box**, **Detail Lines Length**, and **Flip Each Element**; **Detail Lines Length** is now clearly marked unfinished
- Preview windows remember their size, and editable fields across SDX dialogs have more predictable arrow-key, Escape, numeric-entry, and placeholder behaviour
